purpose: Document separate English/local-language searches, first-party local registry/cadastre evidence, and bounded anonymous geometry discovery.
assessment: The state Cadastral Institute is a local first-party cadastre custodian with an office in Oaxaca de Juárez. The official public pages describe registry and cadastral services but do not document a safe anonymous parcel-vector route. The separate georeference portal concerns programme records, not cadastral lots.
registryAssessment: First-party registry, cadastral or land-administration custodian route identified as described in the cited official-source observations; public safe geometry remains unverified.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Oaxaca State Cadastral Institute (ICEO) identifies its role maintaining the cadastral register and territorial information system; lists cadastral data correction, parcel split/merge, registry intake and copy/print services. The official directory places the institute in Oaxaca de Juárez. No anonymous parcel geometry API or response was documented.
Official Oaxaca georeference portal supports searching state-funded programmes by dependency, region, district or municipality; it is not a cadastral parcel feature service.
